_comment: THE RELEASE GATE REGISTER — the single source of truth for release state.
Constitution: 'Never duplicate.' So this file is the ONE place a gate's state lives.
The validation dashboard reads it. The Go/No-Go report is generated from it. CI checks
it. There is no second list to drift out of step with this one.
FOUR STATES (RVS v1.0). A gate is exactly one of them:
not_exercised        ⚪  never run. NO evidence. NEVER report as pass.
engineering_complete 🟡  built, reviewed, tests pass. NOT yet proven in production.
verified             🟢  EXECUTED in the intended environment. Evidence captured.
failed               🔴  executed, evidence captured, expected behaviour NOT observed.
THE RULE: a gate may NOT move from not_exercised to verified without execution.
A gate may NOT be marked verified without a non-empty `evidence` block.
scripts/test-rvs.js enforces both. It fails the build, not a linter warning.
Queued is not Delivered. Accepted is not Completed. HTTP 200 is not Business Success.
Cloud Function success is not User success. Deployment success is not Production success.
verdictReason: 0 of 10 critical gates VERIFIED. 9 are ENGINEERING COMPLETE (built, tested, unproven). 1 are NOT EXERCISED. Engineering Complete is not Production Proven.

gates.name: Authentication
gates.note: Custom authDomain auth.mysokoni.co.ke live — DNS, SSL, Authorized Domains confirmed 2026-07-14. 4 bugs fixed: P0 iOS false-error banner, P2 Facebook redirect missing pending flag, P2 OAuthRedirectDone flag leak, P4 comment drift. ALWAYS_FRESH + SKIP_CACHE_PATTERNS verified. All 54 secondary initializeApp configs migrated. SW reload guard covers Google+Facebook. Code-complete and code-reviewed. PENDING: iPhone Safari + iOS PWA physical device execution. See docs/AUTH_DOMAIN_CERTIFICATION.md.

gates.name: Identity
gates.note: CompanyIdentity canonical across 893 files; drift guard green. Client-side identity (claims, roles) never exercised per-role on a device.

gates.name: Legal
gates.note: Legal engine: 45 regression checks green, mandatory digital signature enforced, three lawful forms. No agreement has ever been signed by a real user.

gates.name: Payments (money path)
gates.note: ZERO orders have ever existed in production. The money path has never taken a shilling. 17 CI checks green and it fails closed — but that is engineering, not evidence. The next payment is SOKONI's first.

gates.name: Wallet
gates.note: Top-up confirms via provider callback and toasts on credit. Never credited a real user with real money.

gates.name: Notifications
gates.note: HIGHEST RISK. The fcmToken/fcmTokens defect is fixed and the engine is the one entry point. But push has NEVER been confirmed on a real device — and sendEachForMulticast() with zero tokens returns SUCCESS, which is exactly how a months-long outage hid behind a green dashboard. Queued is not Delivered.

gates.name: Email
gates.note: SendGrid key is real. The PO email now carries a PDF attachment. But 202 Accepted is not Delivered — no receipt and no PO has ever landed in a real inbox.

gates.name: Search
gates.note: 10 of 12 capabilities real (voice, barcode, QR, typo, autocomplete, trending, nearby, personalised). Image search is a stub. Never exercised on a device.

gates.name: Marketplace
gates.note: Browse/cart/checkout paths built; payment fails closed. Never driven end-to-end by a real buyer.

gates.name: SmartPOS
gates.note: Extensive engineering. No till has ever been opened on real hardware in production.

gates.name: Organizations / Procurement
gates.note: PO chain wired end to end; PDF validated by parsing its xref table. procSuppliers is EMPTY — no supplier exists, so no PO has ever been sent to anyone.

gates.name: Profile
gates.note: Built. Not exercised per-role on a device.

gates.name: Analytics
gates.note: 13 of 15 metrics real with drill-down. Every revenue figure is currently ZERO because no order has ever existed — any non-zero number on a dashboard today is seed or mock data.

gates.name: PWA / Service Worker
gates.note: Live SW matches repo. Validation mode flags a WAITING worker (the session would be running stale code). Offline, install, update, recovery and multi-device never exercised.
